## Evidence and verification
- [ ] Reproduced original failure (RED) with exact command/output
- [ ] Smallest change and targeted test run (GREEN)
- [ ] Related regression tests completed (list exact commands and counts)
- [ ] Main baseline CI compared; introduced vs inherited failures separated
- [ ] No secrets, private personal data or actual account balances included
- [ ] Human-facing QA and rollback notes attached

## Release boundary
- [ ] No destructive data migration or unreviewed third-party scripts
- [ ] Independent technical review completed (if available)
- [ ] CI / build / platform-specific acceptance evidence linked below
- [ ] No production release, deployment or automatic order before required gates pass
